dateline: BTS wrapped Lima (~151,500 fans) and arrived in Santiago; Estadio Nacional shows run Oct 14, 16 and 17.
heroHeadline: Day 4,874: BTS in Santiago for Three Estadio Nacional Nights
heroSubtitle: October 17, 2026 is Day 4,874 since BTS's June 13, 2013 debut. After a sold-out Lima run, the ARIRANG World Tour plays Santiago's Estadio Nacional on Oct 14, 16 and 17 — the group's first Chile shows in almost nine years.
